incident-bot: PAGER: Redwood API error rate spike detected — region us-west-2. 5xx rate > 3% for 5m. Incident severity: SEV2. Pager: @Oli oncall-sre
Oli: I’m awake, looking. any client/customer pages yet?
Jun: support reported increased 429/503 for AcmeCorp via ticket TKT-4521. attaching: https://support.internal/acme/4521
Oli: tailing ingress logs now
Oli: ```bash
kubectl logs -n inference ingress-0 -f | grep "5.." | tail -n 50
```
Maya (infra): I see a spike around 01:12 UTC that lines up with KV eviction events on shard-7
Oli: kv eviction? who changed cache sizing?
Jun: that was me — I rolled a perf tweak: `kv.cache.max_entries` 100k -> 50k at 00:58 UTC to reduce memory pressure (canary -> prod)
Oli: ack. revert to 100k in canary first
Maya (infra): rolling revert to prod now, pushing patch
incident-bot: Deploy started by Maya. CI job: ci/2345
Tess (eng-runtime): note — reverting will likely increase memory usage but should reduce 5xxs; prepping to monitor latency impact
Oli: any quick mitigation while deploy completes? can we route AcmeCorp to enterprise/dedicated overflow?
Alex (prod): I can cut them over to the warm reserved pool. starting now, ETA ~3m
Oli: notify when cutover done
Alex (prod): cutover complete. routing check: traffic -> warm-pool-1. monitoring metrics...
Maya (infra): rollback finished at 1833456880
Oli: metrics: 5xx dropped to 0.6%, p50 latency back to baseline. updating TKT-4521 now
Jun: sorry team — my change was too aggressive, missed a mem-safety guard.
Oli: thanks for owning it. we should capture follow-ups and postmortem. who will draft the postmortem?
Tess (eng-runtime): I’ll start the postmortem doc. Owner: Tess. Target initial draft 48h
Maya (infra): Action items (initial):
- AI1: Add automated pre-deploy KV sizing check (owner: Jun, size: M, severity: S2, due: 2026-03-22, quarter: Q1)
- AI2: Implement canary-duration enforcement + auto-rollback on config regressions (owner: Maya (infra), size: L, severity: S2, due: 2026-04-05, quarter: Q2)
- AI3: Emergency routing playbook + runbook for enterprise cutover (owner: Alex (prod), size: S, severity: S2, due: 2026-03-20, quarter: Q1)
- AI4: Postmortem and evaluation hooks to detect regressions from perf tweaks (owner: Tess (eng-runtime), size: M, severity: S2, due: 2026-03-19, quarter: Q1)
Oli: can we add estimated effort hours for planning?
Jun: AI1 ~= 12h (dev + tests)
Maya (infra): AI2 ~= 40-60h (dev + infra + rollout testing)
Alex (prod): AI3 ~= 6h (doc + runbook + small infra change)
Tess (eng-runtime): AI4 ~= 8h (doc + small eval harness)
Jun: I’ll add unit/integration tests to block risky mem config changes and add a schema that rejects too-small defaults
Alex (prod): recommend tagging AI2 as Q2 roadmap candidate — needs cross-team allocation
Oli: prioritization proposal: AI2 (P0), AI1 (P1), AI3 (P1), AI4 (P2). Rationale: auto-rollback is highest availability leverage and prevents recurrence across services
incident-bot: Incident status changed to: MONITORED -> RESOLVED (SEV2 -> POST). Postmortem link placeholder: https://pm.reports/pm-1833456789
Tess (eng-runtime): posted initial draft here: https://docs/internal/postmortems/pm-1833456789 — please add notes and link any relevant PRs
Maya (infra): tagging security for config-change audit: @Liam-sec
Liam-sec: noted. will review the change history and add compliance comments (ETA 24h)
Oli: scheduling postmortem review meeting to finalize action items. Proposed: 2026-03-18 16:00 UTC (1h). Anyone object?
Jun: works for me
Tess (eng-runtime): works
Alex (prod): ok
Maya (infra): ok
Oli: I’ll create calendar invite and add action items to the remediation board with JIRA IDs after the meeting
Alex (prod): :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Reminder set — follow-up on action item status in 48h
Oli: closing thread in channel to keep noise down. will post updates to the postmortem doc and remediation board as they happen
Alex (prod): thanks all, good coordination on cutover
Jun: will follow up with PR for AI1 and add tests
Maya (infra): will start AI2 scoping doc and add to backlog (Q2 candidate)
Tess (eng-runtime): will link evaluation harness to postmortem doc
incident-bot: Thread archived by Oli at 1833457010
